caption: The image shows a woven textile with a geometric pattern in dark blue and off-white colors. The design consists of large, symmetrical star or cross shapes created by alternating blocks of color, which are arranged in a grid-like composition. The pattern also features stepped, zigzag, and linear elements, especially noticeable along the left and bottom edges, where the design transitions into smaller, repeated motifs and striped sectors. The textile is edged with a narrow, light blue border on three sides, with the right side lacking the border. The overall shape is nearly square, and the background surrounding the textile is a plain, off-white or beige color. There are no other objects or decorations present within the image.
title: Coverlet
